title: PowerPoint on the web: reference webpages when creating a presentation with Copilot Agent Mode
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts and documented product behaviour are supported, and it distinguishes general web-search controls from unconfirmed feature-specific coverage. Two small corrections would make the control row more useful: finish the configuration route and name the Graph property that sets web-search availability.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: The feature's release-note entry does not mention Agent Mode or describe Agent Mode-specific behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint Agent Mode presentation web sources prerequisites specify webpage. Read the complete release-note entry for 555898; it names Copilot in PowerPoint, not Agent Mode.

claims.claim: The release-note entry does not explain how to name a specific webpage.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint Agent Mode presentation web sources prerequisites specify webpage. Opened release notes; the entry asks for a topic benefiting from current web information, with no webpage-selection procedure.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; Scope; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated an on-or-off default for this specific presentation-creation feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint reference webpages presentation feature default enabled admin control; PowerPoint reference webpages default. Read roadmap, feature release note, Copilot settings and web-search policy pages; no feature-specific default found.

claims.claim: The sources do not describe an automatic replacement or change to existing presentation-creation behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint reference webpages presentation feature default enabled admin control. Read roadmap and release-note entry: users can ask to reference online sources; neither describes an automatic replacement of existing behaviour.

claims.claim: The release note identifies current information as a benefit.
claims.quote: Source referencing helps improve presentation accuracy, relevance, and timeliness by allowing Copilot to use current online information.

claims.claim: The release note identifies reduced manual research as a benefit.
claims.quote: This reduces manual research and makes it easier to create presentations grounded in up-to-date sources.

claims.claim: The documented dedicated admin web-search policy is Allow web search in Copilot, available in Cloud Policy service.
claims.quote: The primary way that IT admins can control access to web search is by using the **Allow web search in Copilot** policy, which is available only in Cloud Policy service for Microsoft 365.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The web-search documentation and policy cover Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: This policy applies to both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat.

claims.where: Why it matters; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The cited documentation does not explicitly establish whether this presentation-generation feature uses the documented web-search mechanism and policy.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint reference webpages presentation feature default enabled admin control; PowerPoint web sources policy. Read feature release note, web-search policy, Copilot settings and TCM resource; none connects this generation feature to that mechanism.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Documented Copilot web search sends a generated query to the Bing search service.
claims.quote: Based on these terms, Copilot generates a search query that it sends to the Bing search service asking for more information.

claims.claim: The query excludes the whole prompt unless the prompt is very short, such as local weather.
claims.quote:
The following information isn't included in the generated search query sent to the Bing search service:

- The user's entire prompt, unless the prompt is very short (for example, "local weather")

claims.claim: The Bing web-search request also sends the user's client IP address.
claims.quote: When Copilot sends a web search request to the Bing search service, it also sends the user's client IP address, which Bing uses to help localize results, such as nearby weather and events.

claims.claim: The generated query may be informed by document data when the prompt is entered inside a Microsoft 365 app.
claims.quote:
it may also be informed by data within a Microsoft 365 document under the following conditions:

- When a user enters a prompt into Copilot inside a Microsoft 365 application

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Data Protection Addendum does not apply to generated web-search queries.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Products and Services Data Protection Addendum (DPA) doesn't apply to the use of generated web search queries in Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Copilot Chat, or the Bing search service.

claims.claim: HIPAA compliance does not apply to generated search queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: The EU Data Boundary does not apply to generated search queries.
claims.quote: Also, HIPAA compliance and the EU Data Boundary don't apply to generated search queries.

claims.claim: Generated queries exclude identifying information based on Microsoft Entra ID, including username, domain and tenant ID.
claims.quote: Generated search queries are sent to the Bing search service with identifying information based on the user's Microsoft Entra ID removed (for example, username, domain, or tenant ID).

claims.claim: Learn does not describe identity handling specifically for this feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint presentation web sources search identity query logging Audit. Read feature release note and web-search data-handling page; the former states no identity mechanism and the latter describes general web search.

claims.claim: The release-note entry describes gathering web information, generating slides and reviewing references, but no additional autonomous action.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint Agent Mode presentation web sources prerequisites specify webpage. Read the full 555898 release-note entry: its procedure ends with reviewing generated slides and source references; it describes no additional action.

claims.claim: Disabling web search through the policy turns off and dims the Web content toggle.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns off web search, the **Web content** toggle is turned off and appears dimmed. Users can't turn on the toggle to use web search.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions

claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint reference webpages presentation feature default enabled admin control; PowerPoint web sources policy. Read release notes, Copilot settings and web-search policy; no disabled-state presentation-creation UI is described.

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The web-search policy can target users or user groups.
claims.quote: This policy allows IT admins to either turn on or turn off web search for users or user groups across the tenant they manage

claims.claim: Cloud Policy configurations support targeting Microsoft Entra groups.
claims.quote:
Cloud Policy Service supports the use of Microsoft Entra groups with the following requirements:

- Policies only apply to **user objects**.

claims.claim: The policy offers three options for web-search availability.
claims.quote: If the IT admin enables the **Allow web search in Copilot** policy, they have three options for web search in Copilot:

claims.claim: One option disables web search in Work mode while retaining it in Web mode and Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Disabled in Microsoft Copilot Work mode; Enabled in Microsoft Copilot Web mode and Microsoft Copilot Chat

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: For this commercial-cloud scope, unconfigured Allow web search leaves web search available unless the optional connected experiences policy is Disabled.
claims.quote: If the IT admin doesn't configure the **Allow web search in Copilot** policy, web search will be available to users in both Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat, unless the IT admin has set the **Allow the use of additional optional connected experiences in Office** policy to **Disabled**.

claims.claim: Turning off optional connected experiences restricts multiple Microsoft 365 experiences.
claims.quote: But turning off optional connected experiences restricts Microsoft Copilot Chat, Microsoft Copilot, and multiple experiences across Microsoft 365.

claims.claim: Users can turn off allowed web search themselves through the Web content toggle.
claims.quote: If the IT admin turns on web search for Microsoft Copilot users, those users still have the option to turn off web search by using the Web content toggle.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings > Data access > Web search for Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat opens the Cloud Policy configuration route.
claims.quote: Web search for Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Chat ... Follow the link from Copilot settings to create an **Allow web search in Copilot** cloud policy in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.fix: Keep the documented shortcut and add this continuation to the row note: 'In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, go to Customization > Policy Management > Create > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Allow web search in Copilot.' The configuration route is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365-apps/admin-center/overview-cloud-policy and the policy name at https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/manage-public-web-access; both are already cited.

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors with mode applyOnce and resource microsoft.copilot.allowwebsearch can configure tenant-level web search.
claims.quote: Create a new configurationMonitor object that runs periodically in the background at a scheduled frequency to detect configuration drift in `monitorOnly` mode, or applies a desired-state baseline once in `applyOnce` mode.
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged. Add to the row note: 'Set the baseline resource properties.value to "0" to enable web search in both experiences, "1" to disable it in both, or "2" to disable Work mode while enabling Web mode and Copilot Chat.' These values are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/utcm-copilot-resources#allowwebsearch-resource-type, which is already cited.

claims.claim: The Graph Tenant Configuration Management applyOnce route is preview functionality.
claims.quote: Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) drift remediation and `applyOnce` monitors change workload configuration on behalf of the signed-in administrator. These capabilities are available in preview through Microsoft Graph beta.

claims.claim: TCM supports these Cloud Policy settings only at tenant level and fails for a setting configured in a group-level policy.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center. Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and `applyOnce` fail for that resource.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents generated web-search query logging for audit and eDiscovery.
claims.quote: Web search query logging is available so that admins can perform search, audit, and eDiscovery on the exact web search queries Copilot derived from the user's prompt.

claims.claim: The documentation found does not explicitly establish generated-web-query logging coverage for this presentation-creation feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint presentation web sources search identity query logging Audit. Read web-search logging, feature release note and Audit logs for Copilot. Audit documents PowerPoint interactions and BingWebSearch, not whether this feature uses Bing web search.

claims.claim: Microsoft's feature release note names no administrator action.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot PowerPoint reference webpages presentation feature default enabled admin control. Read roadmap and full 555898 release-note entry; its instructions are to open PowerPoint, ask for a presentation and review results, with no administrator action.

claims.claim: The web-search page expressly includes Researcher, Analyst and Cowork.
claims.quote: The information about web search in this article also applies to Researcher, Analyst, and Cowork in Microsoft Copilot.
